responsibility: Defines and manipulates the special expression forms that represent values and control markers inside compile-time function evaluation. It implements class-reference and thrown-exception wrapper expressions, explicit `void` initialization values, canonical singleton CTFE marker expressions like `<cant>`, break/continue/goto, helpers for copying and validating CTFE literals and references, field lookup within interpreted aggregates, debugging dumps of CTFE values, and recursive construction of `void`-initialized aggregate literals.
